title: Technical Leadership & Client Communication
quote: I worked alongside Miguel on a cybersecurity audit project at Don Bosco Technical College, where he stepped up as team lead to direct an interview with the department head. He created a transcript, documented findings, that we used to evaluate security vulnerabilities. His client-facing communication and initiative during discovery assessments kept our audit thorough and grounded in real operational needs. Miguel is a dependable leader who maintains high standards across both technical deliverables and team coordination.
author: Lance Kennedy Nafarrete
